meaning: r. in an uninterestingly ponderous manner; r. in a heavy ponderous manner
translation_zh: adv. 笨重地；生硬地
example: 他笨重的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n a state of comatose torpor (as found in sleeping sickness); n a feeling of lack of interest or energy; n weakness characterized by a lack of vitality or energy
translation_zh: n. 疲倦, 疲乏, 无精神；[医] 倦怠
example: 这个乏力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a surrounding or nearby region
translation_zh: n. 附近, 邻近, 附近地区, 近处；[法] 附近, 邻近, 附近地区
example: 这个附近为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a gradual decline (in size or strength or power or number); n. the outward flow of the tide; v. flow back or recede
translation_zh: n. 退潮, 衰退；vi. 潮退, 衰退
example: 我们需要逐步ebb这个方案。

meaning: v. become smaller; v. decrease in phase
translation_zh: n. 减少, 衰微, 败落, 亏缺, 月亏；vi. 变小, 亏缺, 衰落, 消逝, 退潮
example: 我们需要逐步wane这个方案。

meaning: n. any of the early patriarchs who lived prior to the Noachian deluge; a. of or relating to the period before the biblical flood; s. so extremely old as seeming to belong to an earlier period
translation_zh: a. 大洪水前的, 陈旧的, 过时的；n. 大洪水以前的人, 老迈的人
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常非常古老的的解释。

meaning: s. represented or appearing as such; pretended
translation_zh: a. 表面的, 假装的, 看得出的；[经] 表面的, 诡称的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常表面上的的解释。

meaning: r from appearances alone
translation_zh: adv. 可公开, 显然, 表面, 外表, 诡称, 假装
example: 他表面上地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n contact by fitting together; n the act of interlocking or meshing; v coordinate in such a way that all parts work together effectively; v hold in a locking position; v become engaged or intermeshed with one another; s linked or locked closely together as by dovetailing
translation_zh: a. 连锁的；[化] 咬合; 咬合作用
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常联锁的v.<计>互锁设备( interlock的现在分词 )的解释。

meaning: a. not given to open expression of emotion
translation_zh: a. 不露声色的, 矜持寡言的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: undemonstratively
translation_zh: adv. undemonstrative的变形
example: 他undemonstratively（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. something that is a source of danger; n. a threat or the act of threatening; v. express a threat either by an utterance or a gesture; v. act in a threatening manner
translation_zh: n. 威胁, 胁迫；v. 威吓, 胁迫
example: 这个威胁为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v pose a threat to; present a danger to; v express a threat either by an utterance or a gesture; v act in a threatening manner; s threatening or foreshadowing evil or tragic developments
translation_zh: a. 恐吓的, 威胁的；[法] 威胁的, 恐吓的, 险恶的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常威胁的的解释。

meaning: r. in a menacing manner
translation_zh: adv. 威胁地, 恐吓地
example: 他威胁的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an event resulting in great loss and misfortune
translation_zh: n. 灾难, 不幸事件
example: 这个灾祸为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s (of events) having extremely unfortunate or dire consequences; bringing ruin
translation_zh: a. 灾难性的, 不幸的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常calamitous（adjective）的解释。

meaning: calamitously
translation_zh: adv. 灾难地;悲惨地
example: 他calamitously（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a not far distant in time or space or degree or circumstances; s being on the left side; r near in time or place or relationship; r (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
translation_zh: a. 在附近的；adv. 在附近地；prep. 近于
example: 他近于地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. severely simple; s. of a stern or strict bearing or demeanor; forbidding in aspect
translation_zh: a. 严峻的, 禁欲的, 简朴的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常朴素的的解释。

meaning: r. in an austere fashion
translation_zh: adv. 严格地；简朴地
example: 他朴素的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the trait of great self-denial (especially refraining from worldly pleasures)
translation_zh: n. 朴素, 苦行, 严格, 严峻
example: 这个（经济的）紧缩为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a behavioral attribute that is distinctive and peculiar to an individual
translation_zh: n. 气质, 特性, 风格；[化] 特异反应; 特异性体质
example: 这个（个人独有的）气质为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. peculiar to the individual
translation_zh: a. 特质的, 异质的, 特殊的；[医] 特[异反]应性的, 特异体质的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常乖僻的的解释。

meaning: a. of or relating to or conforming to idiom
translation_zh: a. 符合语言习惯的, 惯用的, 有许多习语的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常惯用的的解释。

meaning: r. in an idiomatic manner
translation_zh: adv. 使用习语, 惯用地
example: 他idiomatically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. relating to the motion of material bodies and the forces associated therewith; s. characterized by motion
translation_zh: a. 运动的, 运动引起的, 动力学的, 活动的；[医] 运动的, 动的, 动力的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常运动的的解释。

meaning: kinetically
translation_zh: n. 动力学
example: 他kinetically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s having no intervening persons, agents, conditions
translation_zh: a. 无中介的,未经调停的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常unmediated（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v. occupy an intermediate or middle position or form a connecting link or stage between two others; a. acting through or dependent on an intervening agency
translation_zh: a. 居间的, 间接的；vt. 斡旋, 调停；vi. 处于中间, 调解
example: 我们需要逐步mediate这个方案。

meaning: n. a negotiation to resolve differences that is conducted by some impartial party; n. the act of intervening for the purpose of bringing about a settlement
translation_zh: n. 调停, 调解, 中介；[医] 间介[作用], 居间[作用]
example: 这个调停为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: unharried
translation_zh: [网络] 未婚
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常unharried（adjective）的解释。

meaning: r. in a figurative sense
translation_zh: adv. 象征性地；比喻地
example: 他形象地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. freeing from evil spirits
translation_zh: n. 驱魔, 驱邪所用的咒语
example: 这个exorcism（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one of the minor orders in the unreformed Western Church but now suppressed in the Roman Catholic Church; n. someone who practices exorcism
translation_zh: n. 驱魔的人, 召魂者
example: 这个exorcist（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the quality or character of being intellectually sophisticated and worldly through cultivation or experience or disillusionment; n the quality of being commonplace and ordinary
translation_zh: n. 尘俗
example: 这个mundanity（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n ordinariness as a consequence of being average and not outstanding; n a person of second-rate ability or value
translation_zh: n. 平常, 平庸之才
example: 这个平庸为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r in a questionable and dubious manner; r in a doubtful manner
translation_zh: adv. 怀疑地；可疑地
example: 他可疑的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a person authorized to conduct religious worship
translation_zh: n. 助理牧师
example: 我们需要逐步curate这个方案。

meaning: n. the custodian of a collection (as a museum or library)
translation_zh: n. 管理者, 经理, 主管人, 掌管者, 馆长, 大学学监, 监护人, 保护人；[经] 临时监护人
example: 这个（图书馆等的）馆长为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. exact opposite; n. the juxtaposition of contrasting words or ideas to give a feeling of balance
translation_zh: n. 对偶, 对照, 对立面
example: 这个对立为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s sharply contrasted in character or purpose
translation_zh: a. 对立的, 正相反的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常正相反的的解释。

meaning: n. a constant in the equation of a curve that can be varied to yield a family of similar curves; n. any factor that defines a system and determines (or limits) its performance; n. a quantity (such as the mean or variance) that characterizes a statistical population and that can be estimated by calculations from sample data
translation_zh: n. 参变数, 参变量, 参数, 参量；[计] 参量; 参数
example: 这个(限定性的)因素为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v take away a part from; diminish
translation_zh: vi. 减去, 贬低；vt. 转移, 分散
example: 我们需要逐步detract这个方案。

meaning: v. transmit (a signal) for setting off an appropriate response, as in telecommunication; v. pose a series of questions to
translation_zh: vt. 质问, 讯问, 审问；vi. 质问, 讯问
example: 我们需要逐步interrogate这个方案。

meaning: n. a transmission that will trigger an answering transmission from a transponder; n. formal systematic questioning
translation_zh: n. 审问, 疑问句, 问号；[电] 询问
example: 这个讯问为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. relating to verbs in the so-called interrogative mood; a. relating to the use of or having the nature of an interrogation
translation_zh: n. 疑问词, 问号；a. 疑惑的, 疑问的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常interrogative（adjective）的解释。

meaning: adv. In the form of, or by means of, a question; in; an interrogative manner.
translation_zh: 疑问地
example: 他interrogatively（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. marked by a disposition to oppose and contradict
translation_zh: a. 乖张的, 故意作对的, 有悖常情的, 执迷不悟的, 歪曲的, 错误的, 不正当的；[法] 邪恶的, 罪恶的:堕落的, 不合法的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不正当的的解释。

meaning: n. deliberately deviating from what is good
translation_zh: n. 乖僻, 倔强, 任性, 反常, 性变态
example: 这个perversity（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not transmitting or reflecting light or radiant energy; impenetrable to sight; s. not clearly understood or expressed
translation_zh: n. 不透明物；a. 不透明的, 不传热的, 不传导的, 阴暗的；[计] 白底
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（玻璃、液体等）不透明的的解释。

meaning: n. the phenomenon of not permitting the passage of electromagnetic radiation; n. incomprehensibility resulting from obscurity of meaning; n. the quality of being opaque to a degree; the degree to which something reduces the passage of light
translation_zh: n. 不透明, 电波不透过, 不透明体；[医] 浑浊, 不透明, 不透光, 不透明区, 浊斑
example: 这个opacity（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the topic that a person, committee, or piece of research is expected to deal with or has authority to deal with; v. send (money) in payment; v. release from (claims, debts, or taxes); v. refer (a matter or legal case) to another committee or authority or court for decision
translation_zh: vt. 宽恕, 赦免, 免除, 汇出, 缓解, 减轻, 把...提交, 使恢复原状, 推迟；vi. 缓解, 汇款；n. 移交的事物
example: 我们需要逐步remit这个方案。

meaning: n. a payment of money sent to a person in another place
translation_zh: n. 汇款；[经] 汇款, 寄款, 支付(金额)
example: 这个汇款为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. act of turning to for assistance; n. something or someone turned to for assistance or security
translation_zh: n. 求援, 求助, 追索权；[经] 追索权
example: 这个求援为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a position of great esteem (and supposed superiority); n. an architectural support or base (as for a column or statue)
translation_zh: n. 支柱, 基架, 基座, 基础；vt. 加座, 搁在台上, 支持, 提高...的地位
example: 这个底座为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. horrible in fierceness or savagery; s. glaringly vivid and graphic; marked by sensationalism; s. shining with an unnatural red glow as of fire seen through smoke; s. ghastly pale
translation_zh: a. 火烧似的, 苍白的, 华丽的, 可怕的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可怕的的解释。

meaning: r. in a lurid manner
translation_zh: adv. 耀眼地, 骇人听闻地
example: 他可怕的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a misconception resulting from incorrect reasoning
translation_zh: n. 错误的观念(或信念), 谬见, 谬论；[医] 错觉, 幻觉, 虚妄
example: 这个谬误为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s most frequent or common; s excessively abundant
translation_zh: a. 流行的, 盛传的, 充满的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常流行的的解释。

meaning: n. a person hired to fight for another country than their own; s. serving for wages in a foreign army
translation_zh: n. 唯利是图者, 雇佣兵；a. 为钱而工作的, 被雇的, 图利的
example: 这个雇用的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. having or characterized by words of more than three syllables; s. (of words) long and ponderous; having many syllables
translation_zh: a. 多音节的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常polysyllabic（adjective）的解释。

meaning: a. of or relating to syllables; a. consisting of or using a syllabary; a. (of verse) having lines based on number of syllables rather than on rhythmical arrangement of stresses or quantities
translation_zh: n. 音节主音；a. 音节的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常音节的的解释。

meaning: s serving no useful purpose; having no excuse for being; s more than is needed, desired, or required
translation_zh: a. 多余的, 过剩的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常过多的的解释。

meaning: r in a superfluous manner
translation_zh: adv. 过分地; 过剩地
example: 他过多的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n a small piece of anything (especially a piece that has been snipped off)
translation_zh: n. 小片, 片断, 摘录
example: 这个小片为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who practices a learned profession
translation_zh: n. 从业者, 开业者；[医] 行医者, 医师
example: 这个习艺者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. lasting a very short time
translation_zh: a. 朝生暮死的, 短命的, 短暂的；[医] 暂时的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常短暂的的解释。

meaning: n. something transitory; lasting a day
translation_zh: n. 生命短促的人(或物), 蜉蝣
example: 这个ephemera（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the property of lasting for a very short time
translation_zh: n. 朝生暮死, 短命的事物
example: 这个ephemerality（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. without delay; in a summary manner
translation_zh: adv. 概要地, 概略地, 立刻
example: 他概括地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: adv. In an infallible manner; certainly; unfailingly;; unerringly.
translation_zh: adv. 绝对无误地
example: 他infallibly（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. incapable of failure or error
translation_zh: a. 绝无错误的, 绝对可靠的；n. 一贯正确的人
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常绝对可靠的的解释。

meaning: n. the quality of never making an error
translation_zh: n. 绝无错误, 绝对可靠性
example: 这个infallibility（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a corrupt or depraved or degenerate act or practice
translation_zh: n. 堕落, 腐败, 邪恶；[法] 堕落, 腐化, 败坏
example: 这个道德败坏为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. deviating from what is considered moral or right or proper or good
translation_zh: a. 堕落的, 腐化的, 道德败坏的；[医] 恶化的, 变坏的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常depraved（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v. express strong disapproval of; deplore; v. belittle
translation_zh: vt. 声明不赞成, 抗议, 反对；[法] 对...表示不赞成, 反对
example: 我们需要逐步deprecate这个方案。

meaning: adv. In a deprecating manner.
translation_zh: adv. 不赞成地, 不以为然地
example: 他deprecatingly（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v spread negative information about
translation_zh: v. 辱骂, 斥责
example: 我们需要逐步revile这个方案。

meaning: n intense aversion
translation_zh: n. 剧变, 厌恶, 强烈反感；[医] 诱导法
example: 这个剧变为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. requiring secret or mysterious knowledge
translation_zh: a. 神秘的, 晦涩难解的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常秘密的的解释。

meaning: arcanely
translation_zh: arcanely；adv.；arcane的变形；arcane；[ɑ:'kein]；adj.；深奥的，晦涩难解的；神秘的；秘密的；秘传的；限于小圈子内的
example: 他秘密的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: to be a sign or warning that something momentous or calamitous is likely to happen
translation_zh: vt. 预示，预兆（同 portend）；n. 征兆
example: 这个porten（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。
definition_zh: vt. 预示，预兆（同 portend）；n. 征兆

meaning: n. successful conjecture by unusual insight or good luck; n. the art or gift of prophecy (or the pretense of prophecy) by supernatural means
translation_zh: n. 占卜, 卜卦, 预测
example: 这个预言为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sudden quick movement; n. a secret move (to avoid paying debts); v. move along rapidly and lightly; skim or dart
translation_zh: n. 掠过, 迁徙；vi. 掠过, 迁徙
example: 我们需要逐步flit这个方案。

meaning: n. a connection between a vehicle and the load that it pulls; n. a knot that can be undone by pulling against the strain that holds it; a temporary knot; n. the uneven manner of walking that results from an injured leg; v. to hook or entangle
translation_zh: n. 猛拉, 急推, 蹒跚, 故障；vt. 猛拉, 系住；vi. 蹒跚, 被钩住
example: 我们需要逐步hitch这个方案。

meaning: s. having a tendency (to); often used in combination; s. lying face downward
translation_zh: a. 俯伏的, 面向下的, 有...倾向的；[医] 旋前的, 伏的, 俯的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有做……倾向的的解释。

meaning: n. a chemical agent that is added to a chemical mixture to counteract the effects of impurities; n. any animal that feeds on refuse and other decaying organic matter
translation_zh: n. (英)清道夫, 清扫工, 拾垃圾的人, 清除剂, 净化剂, 食腐动物, 黄色作家；[计] 清除器
example: 这个食腐动物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an irritating or obnoxious person; n. any of various small animals or insects that are pests; e.g. cockroaches or rats
translation_zh: n. 害虫, 歹徒；[医] 虫, 体外寄生虫(如蚤、臭虫、蚤等)
example: 这个害虫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. relating to totemism
translation_zh: a. 图腾的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常totemic（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v. strive to equal or match, especially by imitating; v. imitate the function of (another system), as by modifying the hardware or the software; v. compete with successfully; approach or reach equality with
translation_zh: vt. 效法, 尽力赶上, 同...竞争；[计] 仿真
example: 我们需要逐步emulate这个方案。

meaning: n. ambition to equal or excel; n. (computer science) technique of one machine obtaining the same results as another; n. effort to equal or surpass another
translation_zh: n. 效法, 竞争；[计] 仿真
example: 这个emulation（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. pertaining to or characteristic of birds
